# BioBrain

> BioBrain develops practical, science-based AI applications. It combines neuroscience, psychology, cognitive science and information management with a human-centered approach. Founded by Yuval Gal-Shahaf (MSc Applied Neuroscience, King's College London).

## Pages
- [Home](index.html): What BioBrain does.
- [AI Solutions](ai-solutions.html): Human-AI interaction, Scientific Intelligence, science-based wellness AI, regulatory implementation support, business AI and automation.
- [Scientific Intelligence](scientific-intelligence.html): AI-powered platform for scientific literature analysis: Understand, Compare, Ask, Export.
- [About the Founder](about.html): Background, expertise, education and writing.
- [Research summary: oxidative stress and the post-COVID brain](research-summary.html): MSc research proposal (no data collected).
- [Review summary: protecting the brain while treating the infection](review-summary.html): Unpublished narrative review; not clinical guidance.
- [Contact](contact.html): Project enquiries.
